integrity: The exact semiprime classification follows from digit bounds on a product. The limiting constant follows from the prime number theorem, weak convergence of scaled prime blocks to uniform measure, and an explicit area integral. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The phase law is for ordered distinct-prime pairs drawn from complete base-B digit blocks. It does not by itself determine the natural density of equidigital squarefree semiprimes ordered by their product. The 2006 global counting paper was inspected only through its abstract.
title: A universal equidigital phase law for squarefree semiprimes
